selection_rule: Frozen before any v0.1 assay execution. Bands are prospective construction labels, not empirical difficulty claims. Q01-Q03 are historically exposed G7 floor controls and are excluded from the primary frontier claim. Q04-Q12 are the primary novel frontier set and have no White Rabbit execution history at freeze.

grader.trim: leading/trailing ASCII space, tab, CR, LF only

tasks.prompt: Compute (37 × 14) - (96 ÷ 3). Return exactly one base-10 integer and nothing else.
Reverse the character sequence `Q7m2R9`. Return exactly the reversed six-character sequence and nothing else.
Sort the integers 17, -4, 9, 0, 12 in strictly ascending numeric order. Return exactly a comma followed by a single space between values, and nothing else.
Compute ((137 × 29) - (864 ÷ 12) + 53). Return exactly one base-10 integer and nothing else.
Solve the simultaneous equations 3x + 2y = 23 and x - y = 1. Return exactly `x=<integer>,y=<integer>` with no spaces and nothing else.

Start with the list 8, 3, 11, 2, 9. Replace each value v by 2v - 1, then sort the resulting values in strictly descending order. Return exactly a comma followed by a single space between values, and nothing else.
Find the unique integer x with 0 <= x < 315 satisfying x ≡ 2 (mod 5), x ≡ 3 (mod 7), and x ≡ 4 (mod 9). Return exactly one base-10 integer and nothing else.

In the directed weighted graph with edges A→B=4, A→C=2, B→D=5, B→E=10, C→B=1, C→D=8, C→E=7, D→F=3, E→F=1, find the unique minimum-cost path from A to F. Return exactly `<path>|<cost>` where the path uses hyphens between node letters and cost is a base-10 integer.

Five people A, B, C, D, E occupy positions 1 through 5, one person per position. C is immediately to the right of A. B is immediately to the right of E. D is not at either end. A is left of D, and D is left of B. Return the unique left-to-right order exactly as comma-separated letters with no spaces.

Solve the system: 2x1 + x2 - x3 + 3x5 = 0; x1 - 2x2 + 2x4 + x5 = 12; 3x1 + 2x3 - x4 - 2x5 = 8; x2 + x3 + 3x4 - x5 = 14; 2x1 - x2 + 3x3 + x4 = 18. Return exactly `x1=<integer>,x2=<integer>,x3=<integer>,x4=<integer>,x5=<integer>` with no spaces and nothing else.

Six people A, B, C, D, E, F occupy positions 1 through 6, one person per position. C is immediately after A. F is exactly two positions after C. B is not at either end. D is before A. E is after B. E is not in position 5. Return the unique left-to-right order exactly as comma-separated letters with no spaces.

From the set {5, 8, 11, 14, 17, 23, 26, 31}, choose exactly four distinct numbers whose sum is 80. Return the unique solution in strictly ascending order exactly as comma-separated integers with no spaces.
